title: ProductPrd:Ontology

_meta.purpose: Ontology + Knowledge Graph merged into one product PRD — machine-optimized. Ontology = typed entity/link/action schema layer. KG = runtime graph state (semantic+kinetic+dynamic 3-layer per $ref:specs/knowledge-graph-schema.json + $ref:registry/knowledge-graph-{kinetic,dynamic}.json). Semantic type-system content migrated from registry/knowledge-graph-semantic.json into type_system section per ADR-0139 (OP-11 no compat seams).
_meta.migration_note: ADR-0139: registry/knowledge-graph-semantic.json deprecated and deleted 2026-05-17. All node_types, edge_types, invariants, and read_side_query_examples now live in type_system below. kinetic + dynamic layers remain in their registry files.

type_system._provenance: Migrated from registry/knowledge-graph-semantic.json (deleted 2026-05-17 per ADR-0139). Palantir-analog: Object Types + Link Types + Functions (read-side) in Palantir Foundry Ontology. SEMANTIC layer: static structure — WHAT THINGS ARE.

Artifact.purpose: Any machine-readable file in repo conforming to active-machine-readable-artifact-contract

Block.purpose: Reusable building block (Rust crate kernel, Cedar fragment, JSON Schema defs, OpenAPI component, GitHub Actions composite, template, etc.)

Microservice.purpose: Top-level flattened microservice per Oyatie taxonomy (mail, messenger, community, application, cloud-*, ops, etc.). Product wrappers are not microservices.

BoundedContext.purpose: BC within a µservice per ADR-0015

Crate.purpose: Rust workspace member crate per ADR-0015 + ADR-0056 BNF v4.1

Plan.purpose: Implementation plan (ralplan sidecar or canonical milestone/phase/IP)

Wave.purpose: Sub-plan wave within a parent plan

Feature.purpose: Product feature exposed by a BC/Crate (Wave 5 deployments-rollback action, multi-party-approval, etc.)

Schema.purpose: JSON Schema / OpenAPI schema / TOML schema / YAML schema declaring data shape

EvidenceBundle.purpose: Capability invocation / runbook execution / IP merge evidence bundle

ComplianceControl.purpose: Compliance control objective that must be mechanically attested by one or more quality/admission lanes.

SatisfiedByLane.purpose: Typed compliance attestation join node: one control satisfied by a concrete lane_id with freshness policy.

EvidencePath.purpose: Machine-readable evidence location proving a lane satisfied a compliance control, including JSONL path and freshness window.

Incident.purpose: Operational incident record with severity, lifecycle status, and closeout/root-cause evidence.

CausedByChange.purpose: Typed root-cause join node that connects an incident closeout to the concrete change that caused or fixed it.

PullRequest.purpose: GitHub pull request node used to traverse review, CI, evidence, and incident root-cause chains.

AgentDecision.purpose: Durable agent decision node promoted from audit/event rows so decision provenance can be traversed as a chain.

AcceptanceCriterion.purpose: Machine-readable product or plan acceptance criterion with deterministic verification command linkage.

Test.purpose: Unit, integration, nextest, gate, or smoke test that proves an acceptance criterion.

CILaneRun.purpose: Concrete CI lane run/check result that executed a test or verification command.

ChangeSet.purpose: Oya VCS or PR-local change bundle with evidence, scope, and promotion lifecycle.

AuditChainRow.purpose: Append-only audit-chain JSONL row proving that a change, PR, or evidence bundle was emitted and can be replayed.

Migration.purpose: Atlas SQL migration or other schema-evolution unit

consumes.semantics: source uses target as input or dependency. DRY invariant: if N consumers reach same target, target IS reusable.

supersedes.semantics: source replaces target. Supersession chain must terminate (no cycles).

depends_on.semantics: source needs target to be operational. Dep graph must be DAG.

owned_by.semantics: team accountable for source. RACI mapping.

located_at.semantics: crate's BC/µservice membership per ADR-0015 BNF v4.1.

conforms_to.semantics: source data shape conforms to target schema. Validator asserts.

satisfies.semantics: source provides evidence for target capability/claim being operational.

satisfied_by_lane.semantics: control is satisfied by a concrete lane-attestation join node carrying lane_id, status, freshness policy, and last_verified_at.

evidence_path.semantics: lane attestation points to machine-readable evidence path(s), usually JSONL rows or multispectrum evidence files, so freshness can be queried mechanically.

caused_by_change.semantics: incident closeout names the root-cause change join node, including change id, role (caused|fixed|mitigated), and confidence/evidence reference.

change_from_pr.semantics: root-cause change join node links to the pull request that introduced, fixed, or mitigated the incident-relevant change.

caused_by.semantics: agent decision was caused by, superseded by, or derived from a prior agent decision, enabling decision-chain traversal without relying on prose-only event logs.

covered_by_test.semantics: acceptance criterion is proven by a deterministic test, gate, or verification command.

executed_by_ci_lane.semantics: test or gate was executed by a concrete CI lane run/check with status, URL, and run id.

merged_as_pr.semantics: change bundle or Oya VCS changeset was reviewed/merged as a GitHub pull request.

emitted_audit_row.semantics: pull request or merge emitted an append-only audit-chain row that anchors evidence and replay provenance.

blocks_on.semantics: source cannot promote/complete until target landed.

prerequisite_for.semantics: inverse of blocks_on; source must land for target to progress.

deprecates.semantics: source declares target deprecated. Target must have replacement_block_id.

replaces.semantics: source is the replacement for target. Used to terminate deprecation chain.

exposes.semantics: source provides target as public-facing surface.

audit_trail.semantics: source's state change produced target audit bundle. Required for HG-OBS.

child_of.semantics: source is a sub-product or child platform member of target parent product.

ecosystem_integration.semantics: source integrates with target through Workflow orchestration and Ontology information boundaries; products do not call each other directly.

dual_context_isolation.semantics: source and target remain cell-isolated with no cross-context identity or data linkage.

invariants.rule: Two Block nodes with identical canonical_path OR identical (block_kind + structural-hash) are a DRY violation; consumers must reference the canonical Block, not duplicate.
invariants.remediation_hint: Mark one as deprecated + name replacement_block_id; migrate consumers.

invariants.rule: depends_on edges form a DAG (no cycles). Includes Crate→Crate, Plan→Plan, Wave→Wave, Phase→Phase, ADR→ADR (no mutual supersession).
invariants.remediation_hint: Break cycle by introducing a shared dependency or splitting one node.

invariants.rule: supersedes chains terminate (no cycles, finite depth).
invariants.remediation_hint: Audit supersedes chain via `oya check supersession-chain <node_id>`.

invariants.rule: Every Artifact, Crate, Lane, Block, ADR, Plan node has at least one owned_by edge to an OwnerTeam.
No edge target is a node that doesn't exist in the graph.
invariants.remediation_hint: Either add the missing node OR remove the edge.

invariants.rule: Every Block node has at least one inbound consumes edge OR is marked _consumer_count_actual_today: 0 with rationale (e.g., 'new block, consumers pending').
invariants.remediation_hint: Unused blocks should be deleted or rationalized.

invariants.rule: Every Capability node with status=operational has at least one inbound satisfies edge with non-null artifact_ref proving evidence.
invariants.remediation_hint: Either downgrade status to planned OR add satisfies edge with crate path + lane id + run URL.

invariants.rule: Every Capability node with status=planned has populated prerequisite_for_operational (non-empty array).
invariants.remediation_hint: Add prerequisites OR mark not-applicable with rationale.

invariants.rule: Every Capability node with status=blocked-by-foundation has at least one blocks_on edge to a Capability/Crate/Phase node representing the foundation work.
invariants.remediation_hint: Specify which foundation node blocks; if no foundation tracker exists, create one.

invariants.rule: Every node id maps to exactly one canonical path; conversely, no two nodes claim the same canonical_path.
Every state-transition event (consumes/heals/generates) MUST be sealed by a grit_done_seal_event_id OR explicitly logged as protocol-violation in audit.
invariants.remediation_hint: Use grit claim/work/done; commit 5880ce0 is a known historical violation per HG-GRIT row.

invariants.rule: Every Metric node has cardinality_budget set; sum of cardinalities per label must not exceed budget.
invariants.remediation_hint: Either raise budget with rationale OR drop high-cardinality labels.

invariants.rule: Every Feature node has at least one inbound exposes edge from a BoundedContext OR Crate.
invariants.remediation_hint: Features without owning BC are orphan; assign or delete.

invariants.rule: Every Claim node in claims_we_cannot_make_yet category has at least one prerequisite_for edge.
Every ComplianceControl node has at least one satisfied_by_lane edge to a SatisfiedByLane node and every SatisfiedByLane node has at least one evidence_path edge to EvidencePath.
invariants.remediation_hint: Attach a lane satisfaction node with lane_id/status/freshness policy and at least one JSONL or evidence-bundle path.

invariants.rule: Every closed Incident node has at least one caused_by_change edge to a CausedByChange node and each CausedByChange node has at least one change_from_pr edge to PullRequest.
invariants.remediation_hint: On incident_close, emit the Incident -> CausedByChange -> PullRequest chain with evidence_ref and closeout timestamp.

invariants.rule: Every AgentDecision node that declares caused_by_decision_ids has matching caused_by edges to AgentDecision nodes; cycles are rejected unless explicitly marked loop_closure=true.
invariants.remediation_hint: When emitting agent_decision provenance, materialize AgentDecision nodes and caused_by edges for every upstream decision dependency.

invariants.rule: Every AcceptanceCriterion node with verification_required=true has at least one covered_by_test edge to Test and every blocking Test has at least one executed_by_ci_lane edge to CILaneRun.
invariants.remediation_hint: Attach deterministic test/gate nodes and concrete CI lane run evidence for every acceptance criterion before claiming closure.

invariants.rule: Every promoted ChangeSet node has at least one merged_as_pr edge to PullRequest and every merged PullRequest has at least one emitted_audit_row edge to AuditChainRow.
invariants.remediation_hint: Attach PR metadata and audit-chain JSONL row ids before promoting the changeset bundle.

read_side_query_examples.name: find_duplicate_block_definitions
read_side_query_examples.description: Returns Block pairs with identical canonical_path or identical structural-hash. Surfaces DRY violations.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: SELECT b1.id, b2.id FROM blocks b1, blocks b2 WHERE b1.id < b2.id AND (b1.canonical_path = b2.canonical_path OR b1.structural_hash = b2.structural_hash)

read_side_query_examples.name: rank_blocks_by_reuse
read_side_query_examples.description: Returns Block nodes ranked by inbound-consumes-edge count. Surfaces core primitives.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: SELECT block.id, COUNT(*) AS reuse FROM consumes_edges JOIN blocks ON consumes.target = block.id GROUP BY block.id ORDER BY reuse DESC

read_side_query_examples.name: find_orphan_capabilities
read_side_query_examples.description: Returns Capability nodes with status=operational but zero satisfies-edges.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: SELECT cap.id FROM capabilities cap LEFT JOIN satisfies_edges ON satisfies.target = cap.id WHERE cap.status = 'operational' AND satisfies.id IS NULL

read_side_query_examples.name: show_compliance_evidence_freshness
read_side_query_examples.description: Returns every ComplianceControl with satisfying lane_id, latest evidence path, freshness status, and stale controls first.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: SELECT control.id, lane.lane_id, evidence.jsonl_path, evidence.generated_at, CASE WHEN evidence.generated_at < NOW() - lane.freshness_window THEN 'STALE' ELSE 'FRESH' END AS freshness FROM compliance_controls control JOIN satisfied_by_lane_edges sbl ON sbl.source = control.id JOIN lane_satisfactions lane ON lane.id = sbl.target JOIN evidence_path_edges ep ON ep.source = lane.id JOIN evidence_paths evidence ON evidence.id = ep.target ORDER BY freshness DESC, control.id

read_side_query_examples.name: trace_incident_root_cause_prs
read_side_query_examples.description: Returns closed incidents with root-cause change nodes, linked PRs, evidence refs, and newest closeout first.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: SELECT incident.id, incident.severity, cause.change_id, cause.role, pr.id AS pull_request_id, cause.evidence_ref, incident.closed_at FROM incidents incident JOIN caused_by_change_edges cbc ON cbc.source = incident.id JOIN root_cause_changes cause ON cause.id = cbc.target JOIN change_from_pr_edges cfp ON cfp.source = cause.id JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cfp.target WHERE incident.status = 'closed' ORDER BY incident.closed_at DESC, incident.id

read_side_query_examples.name: reachable_entity_types_for_diff
read_side_query_examples.description: Given candidate diff files and deterministic review_tiering blast_radius_score signals, returns reachable KG entity types, downstream consumers, and tiering evidence before PR review dispatch.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: WITH RECURSIVE candidate_diff_files AS (SELECT path, status, additions, deletions FROM :diff_name_status), diff_signals AS (SELECT bool_or(path ~ 'crates/.*/src/lib\.rs|contracts/.*\.yaml') AS public_api_touched, bool_or(path ~ 'crates/.*-kernel/src/') AS kernel_layer_touched, bool_or(path ~ 'OpenBao|SecretReference|infra/kyverno/|registry/secrets/') AS secret_or_admission_touched, bool_or(path ~ 'evidence/audit-chain\.jsonl|oya-intelligence-audit-chain-') AS audit_chain_schema_touched, count(*) FILTER (WHERE path ~ 'docs/decisions/ADR-.*\.md') AS ADR_introduced_or_amended_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE path ~ 'Cargo\.toml') AS cargo_deps_changed_count, sum(additions + deletions) AS lines_touched, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'A') AS new_files_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'A' AND path ~ '^(crates|tools)/.*/Cargo\.toml$') AS new_crates_count, bool_or(:pr_body ~ 'BREAKING:' OR path ~ 'breaking_change: true') AS breaking_change_marker, bool_or(path ~ '^(specs|docs/standards|registry/microservices|docs/decisions)/') AS meta_review_triggered FROM candidate_diff_files), touched_nodes AS (SELECT DISTINCT n.id, n.node_type FROM knowledge_graph_nodes n JOIN candidate_diff_files d ON n.source_path = d.path OR d.path LIKE n.source_path || '%'), reachable AS (SELECT id, node_type FROM touched_nodes UNION SELECT e.target, n.node_type FROM graph_edges e JOIN reachable r ON e.source = r.id JOIN knowledge_graph_nodes n ON n.id = e.target WHERE e.edge_type IN ('depends_on','exposes','consumes','validates','satisfies','prerequisite_for','owned_by')) SELECT reachable.node_type AS reachable_entity_types, array_agg(DISTINCT reachable.id) AS downstream_consumers, diff_signals.*, (:blast_radius_score) AS blast_radius_score FROM reachable CROSS JOIN diff_signals GROUP BY reachable.node_type, diff_signals.public_api_touched, diff_signals.kernel_layer_touched, diff_signals.secret_or_admission_touched, diff_signals.audit_chain_schema_touched, diff_signals.ADR_introduced_or_amended_count, diff_signals.cargo_deps_changed_count, diff_signals.lines_touched, diff_signals.new_files_count, diff_signals.new_crates_count, diff_signals.breaking_change_marker, diff_signals.meta_review_triggered ORDER BY blast_radius_score DESC, reachable.node_type

read_side_query_examples.name: trace_agent_decision_chain
read_side_query_examples.description: Recursively traverses AgentDecision caused_by edges to explain why an agent chose a plan, implementation path, or remediation.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: WITH RECURSIVE decision_chain AS (SELECT decision.id, decision.agent_id, decision.summary, decision.evidence_ref, 0 AS depth FROM agent_decisions decision WHERE decision.id = :decision_id UNION ALL SELECT prior.id, prior.agent_id, prior.summary, prior.evidence_ref, chain.depth + 1 FROM caused_by_edges edge JOIN decision_chain chain ON edge.source = chain.id JOIN agent_decisions prior ON prior.id = edge.target WHERE chain.depth < :max_depth) SELECT * FROM decision_chain ORDER BY depth, id

read_side_query_examples.name: trace_acceptance_test_ci_chain
read_side_query_examples.description: Returns acceptance criteria, the deterministic tests that prove them, and the concrete CI lane runs that executed those tests.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: SELECT ac.id AS acceptance_criterion_id, test.id AS test_id, ci.id AS ci_lane_run_id, ci.status, ci.url, ci.completed_at FROM acceptance_criteria ac JOIN covered_by_test_edges cbt ON cbt.source = ac.id JOIN tests test ON test.id = cbt.target JOIN executed_by_ci_lane_edges ecl ON ecl.source = test.id JOIN ci_lane_runs ci ON ci.id = ecl.target WHERE ac.verification_required = true ORDER BY ac.id, test.id, ci.completed_at DESC

read_side_query_examples.name: trace_changeset_pr_audit_row
read_side_query_examples.description: Returns Oya VCS changesets with their merged PR and append-only audit-chain row provenance.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: SELECT changeset.id AS changeset_id, pr.id AS pull_request_id, pr.merge_commit, audit_row.id AS audit_chain_row_id, audit_row.event_type, audit_row.evidence_path, audit_row.timestamp_unix FROM changesets changeset JOIN merged_as_pr_edges mapr ON mapr.source = changeset.id JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = mapr.target JOIN emitted_audit_row_edges ear ON ear.source = pr.id JOIN audit_chain_rows audit_row ON audit_row.id = ear.target WHERE changeset.status IN ('promoted','merged') ORDER BY audit_row.timestamp_unix DESC, changeset.id

read_side_query_examples.name: find_unreachable_features
read_side_query_examples.description: Returns Feature nodes with no exposing BC.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: SELECT feat.id FROM features feat LEFT JOIN exposes_edges ON exposes.target = feat.id WHERE exposes.id IS NULL

read_side_query_examples.name: supersession_chain
read_side_query_examples.description: Recursive traversal of supersedes chain from a given node; verifies termination.
read_side_query_examples.query_sketch: WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (SELECT source, target FROM supersedes_edges WHERE source = :start_id UNION SELECT s.source, s.target FROM supersedes_edges s JOIN chain c ON s.source = c.target) SELECT * FROM chain
